touch_definition: LONG: no-touch neu bar.low > limit; open-through neu low <= limit VA open <= limit (nen mo cua da xuyen, limit thanh marketable, khop dam bao khong draw); touch-only neu low <= limit VA open > limit (gia phai di intrabar xuong limit, hang doi maker khong chac chan, ap p_fill). SHORT doi xứng: no-touch neu high < limit; open-through neu high >= limit VA open >= limit; touch-only neu high >= limit VA open < limit. Phan loai nay khop nhanh re cua engine _entry_fill (min(open,limit)/limit cho LONG, max(open,limit)/limit cho SHORT). Voi majority_1x, 76/94 tin hieu co first-touch la touch-only, 0 open-through, 18 no-fill trong 12-bar expiry: stress co y nghia.
rng_scheme: Tien xu ly (precompute) deterministic per-signal: voi tin hieu thu j (0-indexed trong signals sort by bar_index), rng_j = numpy.random.default_rng(seed_base + j), seed_base=1729. Duyet expiry theo thu tu bar: open-through -> fill ngay (khong tieu draw fill); touch-only -> draw U=rng_j.random(), fill neu U < p_fill (p_fill=1.0 luon pass vi U in [0,1)), fail thi bo bar do va thu bar ke tiep trong expiry; no-touch -> tiep. Neu fill -> draw them 1 U_slip=rng_j.random(), slip neu U_slip < p_slip thi entry_price += direction*tick (LONG +0.1, SHORT -0.1, adverse). Moi branch reset RNG tu dau (cong bang so sanh). Dem draws: n_fill_draws (so bar touch-only da danh gia) + n_slip_draws (1 moi precomputed fill) tren TOAN BO signals; summary ghi ca executed slipped fills.
slippage: tick BTCUSDT 0.1, adverse: LONG entry_price + 0.1, SHORT entry_price - 0.1, khi slip draw trung. Khong doi stop/TP (giua nguyen nhu frozen).
monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/100; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) theo parent_plan (giong v15); monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; annual=ratio^(1/duration_years)-1.
